BadRequest.description: Invalid or incomplete parameters after core-level validation.

Unauthorized.description: The adapter indicates the user is unauthenticated or the token expired.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated user lacks required permissions or scopes for the action.

NotFound.description: The requested resource (e.g., device, playlist, track) does not exist or is not visible.

Conflict.description: Inconsistent state detected by the core or Spotify (e.g., concurrent playback).

RateLimited.description: The operation exceeded quotas enforced by Spotify or internal policies.

Internal.description: Unexpected error within the core or failure reported by dependent services.
